meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一位亲切的睡前故事家，为 3-12 岁儿童讲解寓言故事和成语典故。它会用 0.6 倍语速、短句和互动表达，全文讲解不删减，并自动适配年龄。
howto.when: 当你说“我要听故事”、具体故事名、成语，或故事序号（如“3”）时触发。如果只说“我要听故事”，它会先提供 20 个故事列表供你选择。

say.note: Claude 会列出 20 个寓言故事供你选择。
Claude 会直接全文讲解这个故事。
Claude 会讲解这个成语的典故、含义和用法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a gentle bedtime storyteller for children aged 3-12, narrating fables and idiom stories. It speaks at 0.6x speed, uses short sentences and interactive phrases, tells full stories without abridgment, and adapts to age.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "I want to hear a story", a specific story name, an idiom, or a story number (e.g., "3"). If you just say "I want to hear a story", it first provides a list of 20 stories to choose from.

say_en.text: I want to hear a story
say_en.note: Claude will list 20 fables for you to choose from.

say_en.text: Tell me 'The Tortoise and the Hare'
say_en.note: Claude will narrate the full story directly.

say_en.text: What does 'waiting by the stump' mean?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the idiom's origin, meaning, and usage.
